Meteg after silluq: manuscript images for the verse-final word at 1 Sam. 17:5

← Back to the case register.

The Aleppo Codex lacks the later meteg at 1 Sam. 17:5.

The Leningrad Codex has a meteg after its silluq at 1 Sam. 17:5.

Cairo CoTP has the silluq alone at 1 Sam. 17:5.

A stroke attached to the lamed ascender in the crop may look like a meteg, but it is part of the scribe's lamed. Ben notes that the other lameds on the manuscript page have the same feature.

Codex Sassoon 1053 has the silluq alone.
